One-click dark mode for **StarDesk 1.6.0** on Windows.

1. Download **StarDesk-Dark-Easy-Patch.zip** below and unzip it.
2. Double-click **Install StarDesk Dark** and choose **Yes**.
3. Pick Dark or AMOLED from **Start > StarDesk Dark Settings**.

To remove it, run **Uninstall StarDesk Dark**. Nothing inside StarDesk is changed on disk. Unofficial fan-made mod; Windows SmartScreen may warn because it is not code-signed.

The source is in **Source code (zip)** below.
